characters.appearance: a slender young red fox with kind amber eyes and a white-tipped tail
characters.distinctive: the patched teal scarf, always knotted on the left
characters.name: Rowan
characters.proportions: long legs, slightly oversized ears, small narrow chest

scenes.image_prompt: A slender red fox in a patched teal scarf stands in a misty clearing, many long shadows reaching toward him.
scenes.narration: Rowan the fox had never once said no. Not to anyone. Not even to himself.

visual_direction.continuity: opens the fable, the scarf is introduced
visual_direction.understand: this fox has a problem with refusal

scenes.visual_intention: Rowan alone in a clearing, many shadows reaching for him.

scenes.image_prompt: The red fox in the teal scarf carries a tall stack of stones, hares and crows waiting in a line behind him.
scenes.narration: The owl asked him to carry stones. The hares asked for his evenings. The crows asked for everything else.

visual_direction.continuity: same scarf, same clearing as scene 1

scenes.visual_intention: Rowan carrying stones while hares and crows queue behind him.

scenes.image_prompt: A tiny fox den in tree roots, dark and cold in the rain, a teal scarf hanging inside the entrance.
scenes.narration: His own den grew cold and empty. No one noticed, because he never said so.

visual_direction.continuity: Rowan absent, his scarf hung inside

scenes.visual_intention: Rowan's tiny den, cold and dark, seen from outside in the rain.

scenes.image_prompt: The red fox in the teal scarf buckles under his stack of stones, one stone rolling down a moonlit slope.
scenes.narration: One night, the weight was too much. A single stone slipped, and it rolled away down the hill.
scenes.visual_intention: Rowan's paws trembling, a stone rolling down a moonlit slope.

scenes.image_prompt: A wise grey owl lifts a stone with a gentle smile, the red fox in the teal scarf watching, surprised.
scenes.narration: Nothing terrible happened. The owl simply picked up the stone and said, 'Thank you for telling us.'
scenes.visual_intention: The owl gently lifts the stone, Rowan watching, surprised.

scenes.image_prompt: The red fox in the teal scarf stands upright before three hares at sunrise, scarf lifted by the wind.
scenes.narration: The next day, Rowan said his first small no. The hares waited. The world did not end.

visual_direction.continuity: Rowan stands taller than in scene 1

scenes.visual_intention: Rowan standing upright before the hares, scarf blowing.

scenes.image_prompt: The red fox in the teal scarf at the entrance of his den, warm light glowing inside.
scenes.narration: And Rowan understood: every yes to others had been a no to himself.

visual_direction.continuity: the den from scene 3, now lit

scenes.visual_intention: Rowan at the den entrance, a warm light inside.

scenes.image_prompt: The red fox asleep in his warm den, the teal scarf folded beside him, soft light.
scenes.narration: A kind yes needs a free no. That is how Rowan finally came home.
scenes.on_screen_text: A kind yes needs a free no.
scenes.visual_intention: Rowan asleep in his warm den, the scarf folded.

title: The Fox Who Always Said Yes
